newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's to open in Ukraine.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's to open in Ukraine.

text.p: McDonalds' Corp said Thursday it will open one of its restaurants in Ukraine on Saturday, making the former Soviet republic the 102nd country to have as McDonald's location.
The newest country is part of McDonald's initiative to become the dominant fast-food chain worldwide.
"What's our global potential? In a word - unlimited," James Cantalupo, president of McDonald's international division, told shareholders at the annual meeting here Thursday.
McDonald's has said it plans to open 2,400 to 2,800 restaurants in 1997, with more than 70 percent located outside the United States.
Cantalupo said international operations, which account for about 59 percent of the company's operating profit now, could contribute over 70 percent in about five years.
